skill.name: seo-content-planner
skill.description: Creates SEO content outlines, topic clusters, keyword plans, publishing calendars, and internal linking strategies.
skill.summary: Plan structured SEO content that aligns topics, search intent, keywords, and publishing priorities.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Both static findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks. The skill contains planning instructions and example output, with no executable shell or Ruby commands.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 30 uses inline Markdown backticks to format a relative documentation path. It does not instruct Ruby or a shell to execute the path.
Lines 78 through 94 form a fenced Markdown example of a content outline. The backticks delimit prose output and contain no executable command.

content.user_title: Plan SEO Content and Topic Clusters
content.value_statement: SEO teams often lack a connected plan for topics, keywords, search intent, and publishing order. This skill creates structured outlines, clusters, calendars, and linking plans.
actual_capabilities: Creates detailed content outlines with audience, intent, keywords, sections, and word count targets.
Builds topic clusters around pillar pages and supporting content formats.
Maps informational, commercial, and transactional search intent to content ideas.
Organizes topics into 30-day to 60-day publishing calendars.
Suggests internal links and creation priorities across planned content.
Identifies content gaps and recommends formats for broader topical coverage.
limitations: Does not retrieve live keyword volume, ranking, or competitor data.
Requires business goals, audience details, and topic context for tailored plans.
Does not publish content or modify a content management system.
Recommendations require validation with current search data and subject experts.

use_cases.title: Build a New Topic Cluster
use_cases.description: Create a pillar page plan and supporting article sequence for a defined audience and business goal.

use_cases.title: Plan an Editorial Calendar
use_cases.description: Turn approved topics into a prioritized publishing schedule with formats, keywords, word counts, and internal links.

use_cases.title: Expand Existing Coverage
use_cases.description: Review a supplied content inventory and identify missing subtopics, search intents, and linking opportunities.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Outline
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO outline for [topic]. Target [audience] with [search intent]. Include a title, primary keyword, sections, and word count.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when planning one article with clear inputs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Topic Cluster
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a topic cluster for [core topic] supporting [business goal]. Include one pillar page, supporting articles, intent, keywords, and internal links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when developing connected coverage around a core topic.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Content Calendar
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [30 or 60]-day calendar for [topic cluster]. Prioritize items by [criteria]. Include format, keyword, word count, links, and sequence.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when converting approved topics into a production schedule.

prompt_templates.title: Find Gaps and Prioritize Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this content inventory: [inventory]. Find missing subtopics and intents for [audience]. Propose clusters, links, formats, priorities, and validation needs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when improving an established content program.

output_examples.input: Plan a beginner article about zero-waste office practices for small business owners.
output: Title: Zero-Waste Office Practices for Small Businesses
Sections: baseline audit, purchasing, waste stations, employee adoption, measurement, and next steps

output_examples.input: Create a topic cluster for payroll automation software aimed at operations leaders.
output: Pillar page: Payroll Automation Software Guide
Supporting content: implementation checklist, manual versus automated payroll, compliance workflow, integration guide, and vendor evaluation
Linking plan: each supporting article links to the pillar and two related articles
Priority: publish the guide, comparison, checklist, integration article, then compliance workflow

output_examples.input: Build a four-week calendar for an approved home energy audit cluster.
output_examples.output: Week 1 covers the pillar guide. Weeks 2 through 4 add cost, checklist, professional service, and improvement articles with planned internal links.

best_practices: Provide the audience, business goal, geographic market, topic scope, and available content inventory.
Validate suggested keywords and priorities with current search data before production.
Review outlines with subject experts and connect each supporting page to a clear pillar page.
anti_patterns: Do not treat generated keyword ideas as verified search demand.
Do not create many overlapping articles that target the same intent.
Do not publish a calendar without confirming production capacity and business priorities.

faq.question: Does this skill perform live keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It proposes keyword targets from supplied context, but does not retrieve current volume, difficulty, or ranking data.

faq.question: Can it create a complete article?
faq.answer: It focuses on plans and detailed outlines. You can use the resulting outline as input for a separate writing workflow.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best plan?
faq.answer: Provide the topic, audience, business goal, search intent, market, existing content, constraints, and publishing capacity.

faq.question: Can it plan internal links?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest links between pillar and supporting pages based on the proposed topic structure.

faq.question: Can it analyze content gaps?
faq.answer: Yes, when you supply an existing content inventory or clear summary. It does not independently crawl a website.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code for prompt-based SEO content planning.
